propertyEvents.result: E-124 left on October 9 but was paid 80 hours, $2,250.00 gross, on October 24. The separation notice gives October 9 as the last day worked, with final pay on the October 10 payroll, and HR shows the employee as terminated. Brookline still shows the employee as active, so the salary ran again for October 10 to October 23, 2026, a period that starts after the last day. Net pay of $1,784.97 was deposited. The cost to HANGS is $2,597.13: $2,250.00 of wages, $172.13 of employer social security and Medicare and $175.00 of benefits. AJ-02 moves it from 6000 Salaries & Wages to 1260 Payroll Overpayment Receivable. Recover the net pay from the former employee, have Brookline process a wage correction so the taxes come back on the fourth-quarter return, and end-date the employee. The close's RJ-05 accrual was computed from this register and carries $1,298.57 of this person's cost (5 of 10 workdays); reduce it by that amount.

task.title: HANGS Construction · October 2026 Payroll Reconciliation
task.description: Reconcile HANGS Construction's October 2026 payroll: both payroll registers employee by employee, the payroll postings to 1400, 6000 and the payroll liability accounts, Brookline's two debits on the bank statement, the tax liability and remittance report, the union wage and fringe schedule, a garnishment order and a separation notice. Ties wages, taxes and withholdings to the ledger and the bank to the cent and tests every employee's pay. Proposes entries for a person. Never posts or changes a payroll.
